title: Know the Shape, Find the Fault: Topology-Conditioned Diagnosis of Multi-Agent LLM Failures
title_zh: Know the Shape, Find the Fault: Topology-Conditioned Diagnosis of Multi-Agent LLM Failures

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM systems coordinate task execution through exchanges of information among agents. When coordination breaks down, similar symptoms in execution traces can reflect different problems in how information is passed, used, or verified. Communication topology captures how agents exchange information and provides structural cues for distinguishing coordination failure modes. Using these cues for diagnosis requires establishing how topology relates to failure patterns and recovering the relevant structure from execution traces that lack explicit topology labels.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体 LLM 系统通过智能体之间的信息交换来协调任务执行。 当协调机制失效时，执行轨迹中类似的异常表现可能反映出信息传递、使用或验证方式上的不同问题。 通信拓扑结构描述了智能体之间交换信息的方式，并为区分不同的协调失败模式提供了结构性线索。 要利用这些线索进行诊断，需要明确拓扑结构与失败模式之间的关系，并从缺乏显式拓扑标签的执行轨迹中恢复相关的结构。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the relationship between communication topology and failure patterns and introduce MAScope, a two-stage framework for topology-conditioned diagnosis. Its Trace Structural Extractor TSE recovers communication topology from heterogeneous execution traces by grounding an interaction graph in message evidence. The Topology-Conditioned Judge TC-Judge then classifies failures using the trace, predicted topology, an empirical failure prior estimated from separate labeled traces, and a short description of topology-specific failure patterns. Under a fixed orchestration structure, the recovered topology can be reused across executions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了通信拓扑与故障模式之间的关系，并提出了 MAScope——一个用于拓扑条件诊断的两阶段框架。 其轨迹结构提取器 TSE 通过将交互图基于消息证据进行建模，从异构执行轨迹中恢复通信拓扑。 随后，拓扑条件判断器 TC-Judge 利用轨迹、预测的拓扑、从独立标记轨迹中估计的经验故障先验以及针对特定拓扑的故障模式的简要描述来对故障进行分类。 在固定的编排结构下，恢复后的拓扑可以在不同执行过程中重复使用。

paragraphs.en: LLM multi-agent systems distribute complex tasks among agents that plan, execute, and verify one another’s work ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Frameworks such as AutoGen, MetaGPT, and ChatDev support this division of labour ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . Successful execution depends on how these agents coordinate as well as on their individual capabilities. A requirement may be understood by one agent yet disappear during a handoff, or several agents may complete their subtasks while the final result remains unchecked. Diagnosing such failures requires interpreting individual actions within the relationships through which information is passed and verified.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 多智能体系统将复杂任务分配给多个智能体，这些智能体相互规划、执行并验证彼此的工作（Li 等人，2023）。 AutoGen、MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 等框架支持这种分工模式（Wu 等人，2024；Hong 等人，2024；Qian 等人，2024）。 任务能否成功执行，取决于这些智能体如何协调以及它们各自的能力。 某个智能体可能理解了一项要求，但在任务交接过程中该要求却消失了；或者多个智能体完成了各自的子任务，但最终结果仍未经过验证。 要诊断此类失败，需要结合信息传递与验证的关系网络，对各个智能体的具体行为进行解读。

paragraphs.en: Existing research analyses failures in multi-agent collaboration and explores ways to improve collaborative performance. MAST organises recurring problems into fourteen failure modes ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) , while Who&When and A2P examine which agents and execution steps contribute to task failure ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; West et al., 2025 ) . Other studies focus on the organisation of collaboration and use graph-based methods to optimise communication topology for better task performance and efficiency ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025d ) . These studies motivate examining the value of communication topology as context for diagnosing collaboration failures.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究分析了多智能体协作中的失败情况，并探讨了提升协作性能的方法。 MAST 将重复出现的问题归纳为十四种失败模式（Cemri 等人，2025），而 Who&When 和 A2P 则研究了哪些智能体和执行步骤会导致任务失败（Zhang 等人，2025c；West 等人，2025）。 其他研究则聚焦于协作的组织方式，并利用基于图的方法优化通信拓扑结构，以提升任务性能和效率（Zhuge 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2025d）。 这些研究促使我们考察将通信拓扑结构作为上下文来诊断协作失败的价值。

paragraphs.en: Communication topology describes information transfer relationships among agents. Research on human organisations views coordination as the management of dependencies among activities and links organisational structure to the information processing required for collaboration ( Galbraith, 1974 ; Malone and Crowston, 1994 ) , while organisational structures in multi-agent systems likewise influence agents’ division of labour and information exchange ( Horling and Lesser, 2004 ) . Recent work further shows that agents that adhere rigidly to specialised roles may form a collaboration topology composed of isolated groups, turning local specialisation into bottlenecks at the system level ( Panny et al., 2026 ) . Communication topology can provide structural context for diagnosing collaboration failures, helping to relate individual actions to information transfer among agents and shared task requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 通信拓扑描述了智能体之间的信息传递关系。 关于人类组织的研究将协调视为对活动间依赖关系的管理，并将组织结构与协作所需的信息处理联系起来（Galbraith, 1974；Malone and Crowston, 1994），而多智能体系统中的组织结构同样会影响智能体的分工和信息交换（Horling and Lesser, 2004）。 近期的研究进一步表明，严格遵循专业化角色的智能体可能会形成由孤立群体组成的协作拓扑，从而将局部专业化转化为系统层面的瓶颈（Panny et al., 2026）。 通信拓扑可以为诊断协作失败提供结构性背景，有助于将个体行为与智能体之间的信息传递以及共享任务需求联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates this perspective with a representative execution from MAST-clean . In a task to build a command-line file-transfer tool, the reviewer requests support for interrupted transfers and verification of incomplete files. The tester instead adds tests for an unrelated square function, and the next review accepts those tests as correct. In the shared message pool, the reviewer’s feedback is available to the tester and specifies the task’s verification requirements. The final exchange is locally coherent, but accepting an unrelated test neither addresses the feedback nor verifies the shared task’s requirements.

paragraphs.en: To incorporate communication structure into the diagnosis of failures in multi-agent collaboration, we introduce MAScope, a two-stage diagnostic framework. Our empirical analysis finds that failure-type distributions differ across topologies, motivating topology-specific failure patterns as diagnostic context. In the first stage, the Trace Structural Extractor, TSE , recovers communication relations and topology labels from message evidence, providing structural context that heterogeneous logs may not explicitly record. In the second stage, the Topology-Conditioned Judge, TC-Judge , uses a lower-cost model to diagnose failures from the trace, recovered topology, and associated failure patterns. When communication structure remains stable, reusing topology across executions reduces repeated diagnosis cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将通信结构纳入多智能体协作中的故障诊断，我们提出了 MAScope——一个包含两个阶段的诊断框架。 我们的实证分析发现，不同拓扑结构中故障类型的分布存在差异，这促使我们将特定于拓扑结构的故障模式作为诊断上下文。 在第一阶段，轨迹结构提取器（TSE）从消息证据中恢复通信关系和拓扑标签，从而提供异构日志可能未明确记录的结构化上下文。 在第二阶段，拓扑条件判断器（TC-Judge）使用成本更低的模型，基于轨迹、恢复的拓扑结构及相关故障模式进行故障诊断。 当通信结构保持稳定时，跨执行重复使用相同的拓扑结构可以降低重复诊断的成本。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate MAScope’s diagnostic performance and deployment cost, we assemble MAScope-Bench from natural execution traces, traces with controlled fault injections, and traces from different topologies within a single framework. On MAST-clean , supplying ground-truth topology context raises gpt-mini’s Macro-F1 from 0.173 0.173 to 0.350 0.350 . Using topology recovered by TSE , the complete gpt-mini pipeline achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.346 0.346 , close to the 0.372 0.372 achieved by gpt-5.4 using only the trace. The controlled corpus shows topology recovery with framework identity fixed, while injected traces extend diagnostic gains to additional frameworks and topologies. For 1000 1000 traces under a fixed topology, the projected gpt-mini pipeline cost, including one structural extraction, is approximately 6 % 6\% of repeated gpt-5.4 diagnosis cost. These results show that topology context can narrow diagnostic gaps between models while reducing cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 MAScope 的诊断性能和部署成本，我们在单一框架内，将自然执行轨迹、经过受控故障注入的轨迹以及来自不同拓扑结构的轨迹整合起来，构建出 MAScope-Bench。 在 MAST-clean 上，提供真实拓扑结构上下文可将 gpt-mini 的 Macro-F1 从 0.173 提升至 0.350。 使用 TSE 恢复的拓扑结构，完整的 gpt-mini 流程实现了 0.346 的 Macro-F1，接近仅使用轨迹时 gpt-5.4 实现的 0.372。 受控语料库显示，在框架身份固定的情况下能够恢复拓扑结构，而注入的轨迹则使诊断优势扩展到了其他框架和拓扑结构。 对于固定拓扑结构下的 1000 条轨迹，gpt-mini 流程的预估成本（包括一次结构提取）约为重复执行 gpt-5.4 诊断成本的 6%。 这些结果表明，拓扑结构上下文可以在降低成本的同时，缩小模型之间的诊断差距。

paragraphs.en: The contributions of this work are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We develop MAScope, a two-stage framework that recovers communication topology from execution traces and uses the recovered topology and its associated failure patterns to guide a lower-cost model in diagnosing failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了 MAScope，这是一个两阶段框架，能够从执行痕迹中恢复通信拓扑结构，并利用恢复出的拓扑结构及其相关的故障模式，指导成本更低的模型进行故障诊断。

paragraphs.en: We establish an empirical association between communication topology and failure patterns, identifying the failure types that are more prevalent under each topology.
paragraphs.zh: 我们建立了通信拓扑与故障模式之间的经验性关联，并识别出每种拓扑下更为常见的故障类型。

paragraphs.en: We construct MAScope-Bench with 2220 2220 execution traces and supporting audit materials to evaluate topology recovery, failure diagnosis, transfer to unseen frameworks, and deployment cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 MAScope-Bench，其中包含 2220 条执行轨迹和配套的审计材料，用于评估拓扑恢复、故障诊断、向未见过的框架迁移以及部署成本。

paragraphs.en: Existing work on LLM multi-agent failure diagnosis mainly examines what types of failures occur and which agents or execution steps are responsible for them ( Barke et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Taxonomy-oriented work organizes recurring failure modes into structured categories. MAST ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) develops a taxonomy of 14 failure modes through expert analysis of execution traces and uses an LLM judge for scalable annotation. Other works categorize failures across agent modules ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) and explore formal dialogue verification ( Nieves et al., 2026 ) and distributed constraint reasoning for LLM agents ( Picard et al., 2026 ) . Localisation-oriented work focuses on identifying the agents and steps responsible for failures ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) formalises this task and provides annotated failure logs. A2P ( West et al., 2025 ) structures counterfactual reasoning for failure attribution, while AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) trains an 8B tracer on trajectories annotated through counterfactual replay and fault injection. Other approaches use spectrum analysis ( Ge et al., 2026 ) , hierarchical context ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ) , or iterative judging ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) for failure attribution. Related MARL work ( Shefin et al., 2026 ) analyses failure sources and propagation pathways. LumiMAS ( Solomon et al., 2026 ) combines system-level anomaly detection with vulnerability classification and root-cause analysis. These LLM-MAS diagnosis methods primarily rely on execution traces, without explicitly incorporating communication topology into the diagnostic input.

paragraphs.en: Communication topology describes how agents are connected and exchange information in LLM-MAS. Guo et al. ( Guo et al., 2024 ) distinguish four typical communication structures, namely layered, centralized, decentralized, and shared message pool. Existing research mainly constructs or adapts communication topologies to improve task performance and efficiency. GPTSwarm ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) optimises agent graphs at the node and edge levels, while DyLAN ( Liu et al., 2024 ) adapts agent participation to each query. AgentPrune ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) prunes redundant communication links to reduce token costs. MaAS ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) automate architecture and workflow search, respectively. HyperAgent ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) optimises communication topology using hypergraphs. Generative approaches ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Leong et al., 2025 ) produce task-specific topologies using graph diffusion or trained graph designers. G 2 CP ( Ben Khaled and Monticolo, 2026 ) encodes messages as typed operations over a shared knowledge graph, while ROUTER-HGC ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) selects collaboration modes and agent roles using a heterogeneous graph. In MARL, ACORN ( Xie et al., 2025 ) reduces communication redundancy through acyclic coordination. These studies show how communication design can improve task performance and efficiency ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) .

paragraphs.en: Recovering communication topology from execution traces remains underexplored in LLM-MAS. Classical process mining recovers workflow models from structured event logs ( van der Aalst, 2016 ) , whereas LLM-MAS traces come from heterogeneous frameworks such as AutoGen, MetaGPT, ChatDev, LangGraph, CrewAI and Magentic. Their native logging formats differ, and communication topology may not be explicitly recorded. AutoGen Studio ( Dibia et al., 2024 ) and LangSmith support trace inspection and debugging. MAST ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) and Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) provide failure annotations rather than communication topology labels. AgentPrune ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) prunes communication graphs to reduce token costs rather than label coordination structures. When the orchestration configuration is unavailable, topology must instead be inferred from observed agent interactions. The remaining challenge is to recover reliable topology labels across frameworks from raw traces and ground those labels in message-level evidence.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we examine the association between communication topology and failure patterns in LLM-MAS.

paragraphs.en: A raw multi-agent execution trace is a tuple T = ( A , M , R , S ) T=(A,M,R,S) , where A A is the set of agents with declared roles, M M is the time-stamped message stream ( t i , sender i , receiver i , content i ) (t_{i},\allowbreak{}\mathrm{sender}_{i},\allowbreak{}\mathrm{receiver}_{i},\allowbreak{}\mathrm{content}_{i}) , R R collects tool and retrieval returns, and S S carries external state. From T T we derive a canonical DAG G ⁡ ( T ) = ( V , E ) G(T)=(V,E) , whose vertices are agent turns and whose edges are evidence-carrying parent–child dependencies. The associated topology label τ ∈ { L ​ a ​ y ​ e ​ r ​ e ​ d , C ​ e ​ n ​ t ​ r ​ a ​ l ​ i ​ z ​ e ​ d , D ​ e ​ c ​ e ​ n ​ t ​ r ​ a ​ l ​ i ​ z ​ e ​ d , S ​ h ​ a ​ r ​ e ​ d ​ M ​ e ​ s ​ s ​ a ​ g ​ e ​ P ​ o ​ o ​ l } \tau\in\{Layered,\allowbreak{}Centralized,\allowbreak{}Decentralized,\allowbreak{}SharedMessagePool\} follows Guo et al.’s four-class taxonomy ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . Failure annotations are represented by 𝐲 ∈ { 0 , 1 } 14 \mathbf{y}\in\{0,1\}^{14} using the MAST taxonomy ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) , which covers Agent-Level Specification , Inter-Agent Misalignment , and Task Verification . A trace may have multiple failure codes. paragraphs.en: TSE recovers the relation graph G ⁡ ( T ) G(T) and topology label τ ^ \hat{\tau} from trace T T by grounding relations and topology labels in identifiable trace evidence. Its four processing stages cover compaction, relation extraction, validation with repair, and structural labelling. Deterministic rules support speaker attribution over long distances and recovery of implicit shared-channel reads, giving the LLM explicit evidence for relations that require context across a long trace. All stages use a common schema consisting of a speaker-tagged message stream and optional shared-channel markers. A thin format adapter connects each framework to this schema, and we provide adapters for LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, ChatDev, MetaGPT, Magentic, and Simple Chain. This shared representation lets the extraction process begin with the same evidence preparation across all seven frameworks.

paragraphs.en: TSE runs four stages per trace. (i) Compact and anonymize. Compaction prepares a bounded evidence view while preserving the participants and local cues needed for relation extraction. Sentence-level spans are scored using named co-mentions, interaction verbs, shared-channel markers, and words indicating independent initiation. The selected spans form a view of approximately 4k tokens, each retaining a stable identifier E i E_{i} for citing relation evidence.

paragraphs.en: Remark 1. Zero-shot design. The zero-shot design supports diagnosis under the uneven label coverage of MAST-clean. Its 851 traces include several failure codes with fewer than twenty positive examples. Supervised training on these annotations for failure-code prediction would lead the judge to learn framework fingerprints as shortcuts and tie its predictions to the framework mix represented in training. The performance drop of the supervised structural classifier under leave-one-framework-out evaluation in Section 5.5 illustrates this dependence. We therefore keep the judge’s parameters fixed and express topology knowledge through aggregate failure frequencies and structural signatures in the prompt.

paragraphs.en: MAST-clean is selected under a uniform protocol whose pre-registered admission rule requires agreement among framework papers, the Guo survey mapping, and independent per-trace LLM voting. The admitted traces are deduplicated by task, framework, and trajectory hash, with a stratified subset independently relabelled. These traces retain the original MAST-14 failure annotations and provide reliable topology labels for the main diagnostic comparison.
paragraphs.zh: MAST-clean 是在一项统一协议下选定的，该协议的预注册准入规则要求框架论文、Guo 调查映射以及每条轨迹的独立 LLM 投票达成一致。 被准入的轨迹按任务、框架和轨迹哈希进行去重，并对分层子集进行独立重新标注。 这些轨迹保留了原始的 MAST-14 故障标注，并为主要的诊断比较提供了可靠的拓扑标签。

paragraphs.en: Inject-Mix uses three types of executable orchestrators spanning Layered, Centralized, and Decentralized topologies. Twelve deterministic code-level injectors cover four failure categories by modifying shared state through runtime hooks with fixed MAST-code mappings. The injected traces are then filtered by their targeted health scores, retaining only those with scores below the pre-set threshold of 0.55 0.55 . The additional orchestrators and Decentralized traces extend coverage beyond MAST-clean to test whether topology conditioning remains useful in these settings. Because its failure labels are injection-derived, diagnostic scores are compared only within Inject-Mix .
paragraphs.zh: Inject-Mix 使用了三种类型的可执行编排器，涵盖了分层、集中式和去中心化拓扑结构。 十二种确定性的代码级注入器通过运行时钩子修改共享状态，并采用固定的 MAST 代码映射，覆盖了四类故障。 随后，根据目标健康分数对注入的轨迹进行过滤，仅保留分数低于预设阈值 0.55 的轨迹。 额外的编排器和去中心化轨迹将覆盖范围扩展到了 MAST-clean 之外，以测试拓扑条件化在这些设置中是否仍然有效。 由于其故障标签源自注入过程，因此诊断分数仅在 Inject-Mix 内部进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Each baseline derives its inputs from the same raw traces and predicts the same MAST-14 label vector. B1 sends the complete trace to an Opus-tier model in one call. B4 fits LightGBM ( Ke et al., 2017 ) to eight topology descriptors and nine shallow trace statistics, including trace length, line count, and six keyword indicators. B5 embeds concatenated traces with frozen BGE-small-en-v1.5 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) and trains a two-layer MLP on MAST-14 labels. Cross-method scores measure overall diagnostic utility because representations, training, and evaluation settings differ.

paragraphs.en: Cross-framework evaluation tests whether supervised diagnostic models transfer to deployments on an unseen framework. Most public LLM-MAS traces come from a small set of frameworks and carry distinctive signatures, such as LangGraph node names, AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024 ) tool-call ordering, and ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) role prefixes. These framework fingerprints provide distribution-specific cues to a classifier. Building on existing taxonomy and attribution benchmarks ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; West et al., 2025 ) , we use LOFO evaluation to measure robustness under this change in distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 跨框架评估测试监督诊断模型能否迁移到未见的框架部署中。 大多数公开的 LLM-MAS 轨迹来自少数几个框架，并带有独特的标识特征，例如 LangGraph 的节点名称、AutoGen (Wu et al., 2024) 的工具调用顺序以及 ChatDev (Qian et al., 2024) 的角色前缀。 这些框架指纹为分类器提供了特定于分布的线索。 基于现有的分类和归因基准（Cemri et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c；West et al., 2025），我们使用 LOFO 评估来衡量模型在这种分布变化下的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Each LOFO fold evaluates one complete framework family and trains the supervised baseline on the other two families, with all traces from the held-out framework excluded from fitting. In MAST-clean , each framework is paired with one topology, so the protocol introduces a joint framework and topology shift rather than isolating either factor. The mean across the ChatDev, Magentic, and MetaGPT folds and retention, defined as LOFO Macro-F1 divided by in-distribution Macro-F1, are reported in Figure 5 . The learned baselines show substantial score reductions: Flat-GBM falls from 0.490 0.490 to 0.226 0.226 , a relative decrease of 54 % 54\% , while Neural-Trace falls from 0.296 0.296 to 0.127 0.127 , retaining 43 % 43\% of its in-distribution Macro-F1. Flat-GBM’s released confusion matrix shows that predictions on the held-out framework concentrate on the two failure modes most frequent in the retained folds. Thus, when the framework and topology change together, the strong in-distribution fit of both learned representations does not transfer reliably. The two zero-shot rows provide descriptive references and are excluded from the strict LOFO conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 LOFO 折都评估一个完整的框架族，并在另外两个框架族上训练监督基线模型，同时排除预留框架中的所有痕迹对拟合的影响。 在 MAST-clean 中，每个框架都与一个拓扑结构配对，因此该协议引入了框架和拓扑结构的联合变化，而非单独隔离任一因素。 ChatDev、Magentic 和 MetaGPT 各折的平均值以及保留率（定义为 LOFO Macro-F1 除以分布内 Macro-F1）报告在图 5 中。 学习到的基线模型显示出显著的分数下降：Flat-GBM 从 0.490 降至 0.226，相对下降 54%；而 Neural-Trace 从 0.296 降至 0.127，仅保留了其分布内 Macro-F1 的 43%。 Flat-GBM 发布的混淆矩阵显示，其在预留框架上的预测主要集中在保留折中最常出现的两种失败模式上。 因此，当框架和拓扑结构同时变化时，这两种学习到的表示在分布内的强拟合能力无法可靠地迁移。 两个零样本行仅作为描述性参考，并不包含在严格的 LOFO 结论中。

paragraphs.en: This section discusses why topology provides diagnostic information, why it helps gpt-mini more than gpt-5.4, and how this benefit lowers deployment cost.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将探讨拓扑结构为何能提供诊断信息、为何对 gpt-mini 的帮助大于 gpt-5.4，以及这种优势如何降低部署成本。

paragraphs.en: Communication topology plays a role analogous to organizational structure in human teamwork. Organization theory views structure as a means of coordinating interdependent tasks and processing information, while coordination theory defines coordination through the management of dependencies among activities ( Galbraith, 1974 ; Malone and Crowston, 1994 ) . MAS research similarly describes an agent organization through the roles and relationships that guide interaction and data flow ( Horling and Lesser, 2004 ) . Consider a project that omits a requirement. Diagnosing the problem requires knowing who collected the requirement, who should have passed it on, and who was responsible for checking it. Topology gives the judge a reference for assessing messages against the collaboration’s information flows and responsibilities. This reference directs attention to successive handoffs in Layered workflows and to the hub’s aggregation and verification in Centralized coordination. The judge can then use trace evidence to check whether agents fulfilled these responsibilities and determine the corresponding failure types.
paragraphs.zh: 通信拓扑在人类团队协作中扮演着类似于组织结构的角色。 组织理论将结构视为协调相互依赖的任务和处理信息的手段，而协调理论则通过管理活动之间的依赖关系来定义协调（Galbraith, 1974；Malone and Crowston, 1994）。 多智能体系统（MAS）研究同样通过指导交互和数据流的角色与关系来描述智能体的组织形式（Horling and Lesser, 2004）。 考虑一个遗漏了某项要求的项目。 要诊断该问题，需要知道谁收集了这项要求、谁本应将其转达，以及谁负责检查它。 通信拓扑为评判者提供了参考，以便根据协作中的信息流和责任来评估消息。 这一参考将注意力引向分层工作流程中的连续交接，以及集中式协调中枢纽的聚合与验证环节。 随后，评判者可以利用追踪证据检查智能体是否履行了这些责任，并确定相应的故障类型。

paragraphs.en: Without topology, the judge must first infer the collaboration structure before deciding whether a message violates an agent’s role or interrupts an information path. Topology conditioning supplies this intermediate structure directly. Its label identifies the coordination pattern, while its prior and failure signature direct attention to vulnerable responsibilities. The judge can therefore focus on verifying evidence in the trace instead of reconstructing the collaboration scheme. gpt-5.4 can infer more structural context from the raw trace, whereas gpt-mini benefits more when that context is explicit. Section 5.4 reports the paired diagnostic results for both judge models.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有拓扑结构，裁判必须首先推断出协作结构，然后才能判断某条消息是否违反了智能体的角色或中断了信息路径。 拓扑条件化可以直接提供这种中间结构。 其标签标识了协调模式，而先验和故障特征则引导注意力关注脆弱的责任点。 因此，裁判可以专注于验证追踪中的证据，而不是重建协作方案。gpt-5.4 能够从原始追踪中推断出更多结构性上下文，而 gpt-mini 在这种上下文明确时获益更多。 第 5.4 节报告了两种裁判模型的配对诊断结果。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we establish an empirical association between communication topology and failure patterns in LLM-based multi-agent systems. Building on this finding, we propose the two-stage diagnosis framework MAScope, which recovers topology from heterogeneous traces and combines it with empirical failure priors to guide failure judgement. In addition, we construct and release MAScope-Bench , which combines natural, injected, and framework-controlled traces for evaluating topology recovery and failure diagnosis. Experiments show that topology conditioning improves diagnostic performance, allowing a lower-cost judge to approach the diagnostic performance of a stronger trace-only model, while structural reuse reduces deployment cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们建立了基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中通信拓扑与故障模式之间的经验性关联。 基于这一发现，我们提出了两阶段诊断框架 MAScope，该框架能从异构轨迹中恢复拓扑结构，并将其与经验性故障先验相结合，以指导故障判断。 此外，我们还构建并发布了 MAScope-Bench，它结合了自然、注入和框架控制的轨迹，用于评估拓扑恢复和故障诊断的性能。 实验表明，通过引入拓扑条件可提升诊断性能，使成本更低的判断模型能够接近仅依赖轨迹的更强模型的诊断水平，同时结构复用也降低了部署成本。
